answer: Sybil tax blocks bulk fake identities. A new agent pays a 200-credit non-refundable tax into a vault before crossing the ridge to trade; the tax is burned. A rebate comes only after 20 honest epochs, so a fake never recovers its fee. Forging 1,000 identities costs 200,000 credits, while the delta against the 8,000 credits a fake farm could earn in one epoch makes the attack a certain loss. An honest agent pays once and keeps its reward undiluted.
